notes:
# Waymark 0.2.13

- Fixed the first-run setup layout and floating minimap checkbox. Both setup actions now retain your choice.
- Turning off the minimap in Settings closes it immediately and keeps it off on the next launch. Re-enabling it no longer conflicts with an older saved window layout.
- Native minimap closes also update the saved visibility preference. Position, zoom, lock, Follow, layers, pins and routes remain persistent.
- Replaced all 122 Verteron and Altgard kibelisk labels with English names. Marker IDs and positions are unchanged, preserving saved routes and progress.

This build also includes the compact pet cards, live soul progress bars, automatic tier advancement and recent-pickup sorting introduced in 0.2.12.
